description: This file defines the ExternalOAuthProviderController class, which extends SugarController, and implements an action method for editing views related to external OAuth providers within the SuiteCRM application. It manages view settings, request handling, and access control logic related to OAuth provider configuration.

classes.name: ExternalOAuthProviderController
classes.description: A controller class for handling OAuth provider management in SuiteCRM, extending the base SugarController class. Implements view rendering and access control for editing OAuth provider details.

methods.name: action_EditView
methods.description: Sets up the edit view for OAuth provider configuration, manages request parameters, and checks user access rights.
